view.scene_description: A brightly lit convenience store aisle with shelves stocked with snacks and packaged goods. A man in a white shirt browses near a fruit display of oranges. Decorative hot air balloon lights hang from the ceiling. The perspective is slightly blurred, suggesting motion or a handheld shot.

objects.label: man
objects.observation: Wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and dark pants, he stands facing downward, seemingly selecting an item from a fruit display. His posture suggests focused attention on the produce. He is positioned left of center, partially obscuring the fruit display.

objects.label: fruit display
objects.observation: A wooden crate filled with bright orange citrus fruits, likely oranges, sits on a shelf. The fruits are piled high and appear fresh. The display is located in the lower-left foreground, directly in front of the man.

objects.label: shelves
objects.observation: Multiple metal shelving units line the right side of the aisle, densely packed with colorful snack boxes and packaged goods. The items are arranged neatly but appear slightly blurred due to motion or shallow depth of field. Shelves extend into the background.

objects.label: decorative lights
objects.observation: Several hot air balloon-shaped pendant lights hang from the black ceiling. They are yellow and white striped, adding a whimsical touch. Lights are spaced along the ceiling above the aisle, casting even illumination.

objects.label: ceiling lights
objects.observation: Long, rectangular fluorescent light fixtures are mounted to the black ceiling, providing bright overhead lighting. They run parallel to the aisle, illuminating the entire space evenly. Some fixtures are partially obscured by the decorative lights.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_dense_test50/image-000017", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
